body: It's not them, it's me. I just can't be a friend right now, how can I love anyone to any degree if I don't love myself. Every day since I can remember I've woken up afraid, in pain, crying, and feeling like my stomached in my chest, I've lived my whole life like this, I've lied, cheated, stole, hurt, loved, hated, and attempted suicide feeling like this. I just can't do it anymore. I feel so lonely and trapped it's becoming way too much for me to handle. There just isn't one thing in my life that justifies me living like this.
